name: ebpf-xdp-networking
description: Use this skill when the user says 'XDP', 'eBPF networking', 'in-kernel packet processing', 'AF_XDP', 'eBPF verifier', 'DDoS filtering in kernel'. Explains XDP packet processing at the NIC driver hook and eBPF verifier constraints. Do NOT use for: userspace kernel-bypass (use niche/hft/kernel-bypass-dpdk) or eBPF security detection (use cybersecurity/ebpf-threat-detection).
